messages:
samira (release): Morning async — slice-42 canary update: we ramped to 3% at 06:10 PT and saw intermittent 500s around 06:28-06:40. What I did: rolled back to 1% at 06:45, opened INF-421. Blockers: need SRE confirmation if this is memory/GC churn or an input spike. Today: coordinate hotfix vs hold; decision call 08:30 PT. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/slices/42

priya (sre): I saw the spike. p95 latency and mem on gw-32 spiked. Preliminary: KV cache miss storm + GC thrash. Will grab heap profiles in ~10m and report back.

alex (eng): Pushed a canary config to reduce batch_size -> 16 on slice-42. CI deploy queued (#1973). Command I ran: ```bash
curl -X POST https://infra/api/slices/42/config -d '{"batch_size":16}'
``` Monitoring now.

deploy-bot: canary update: slice-42 batch_size changed -> 16. Traffic adjusted 3% -> 2% (auto rollback policy applied).

marco (product): @samira any user-facing impact noted? failing journeys we should flag?

alex (eng): No user-facing errors in synthetic checks. Only backend 500s from model-serving. Quick smoke: `curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d 'input=test' | jq .status` => OK

jordan (devex): Alex — please drop PR link for the config change so I can check telemetry tags. Ping me when it's up.

alex (eng): PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/slices-config/PR-582 — small env var + telemetry tags included.

priya (sre): Heap dump snippet: ```
[heap] Node gw-32: 92% used, GC thrash, recent OOM killer at 06:39
``` Plan: keep traffic at 1-2%, collect profiles for 30m, then reassess.

samira (release): Decision: hold at 2% until 09:00 PT. If error rate <0.2% and p95 < 350ms for 30m, ramp to 10%. Otherwise rollback to 0% and push hotfix. @marco please notify CS/PMs. @jordan please start a postmortem doc.

marco (product): Notifying CS/PMs now. Also drafting a short customer-facing note in case we rollback.

jordan (devex): Doc stub created: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INF-421-draft — everyone add notes as we get them.

samira (release): Quick ask: Any outstanding code review for the hotfix branch? If none, @alex can you open for expedited review? :thumbsup:

alex (eng): No blockers from my side, opening expedited PR now.

deploy-bot: Alerting rule 'slice-42-500s' muted for 30m by priya (quiet window while we stabilize).

samira (release): Thanks team — will post a brief recap at 09:05 PT with the 30m metrics. If anything changes before then, ping here. :eyes:
